Dana Ortiz: Following up on the tensor shard OOM postmortem 1 compiled an action list with owners/timelines. Please claim or reassign by EOD.
Arjun Rao: Can you drop the list inline? I'll take infra items.
Dana Ortiz: List (condensed):
- ACT-A: Narrow repro and test vectors for shard edge cases 1 owner: Arjun 1 due: 2026-04-04 1 JIRA: RED-3301
- ACT-B: Gateway backpressure + 429 semantics for short spikes 1 owner: Kim 1 due: 2026-04-12 1 JIRA: RED-3302
- ACT-C: Update Dedicated autoscaler cooldowns and add rollback guards 1 owner: SRE Team 1 due: 2026-04-18 1 JIRA: RED-3303
- ACT-D: Cross-postmortem recurrence review + mitigation epic 1 owner: Dana 1 due: 2026-04-25 1 JIRA: RED-3304
Arjun Rao: I'll take ACT-A. Repro script and dataset location?
Dana Ortiz: Repro + traces at s3://pm-artifacts/tensor-shard/2026-03. Shared access to @Arjun and @Kim.
AlertBot: Created JIRA RED-3301 (https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RED-3301)
AlertBot: Created JIRA RED-3302 (https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RED-3302)
AlertBot: Created JIRA RED-3303 (https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RED-3303)
AlertBot: Created JIRA RED-3304 (https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RED-3304)
Kim Barnes: For ACT-B, propose feature-flagged rollout + 40% canary for 48h, watch 429-rate and P99 tail. Will add RFC to RED-3302.
SRE Team: For ACT-C, I'll pair with Ops for a handoff checklist: current cooldowns export, test harness, metric thresholds, emergency rollback steps. We'll paste checklist into RED-3303.
Dana Ortiz: RACI quick draft: ACT-A resp=Arjun acct=PlatformLead consult=ML-eng informed=PM. ACT-B resp=Kim acct=Product consult=Infra informed=CS. ACT-C resp=SRE acct=InfraLead consult=Ops informed=Oncall. Will paste final RACI in PM doc.
Arjun Rao: One more: tag RED-3301 with recurrence and link 2025-11 incident. If this keeps repeating we should escalate to an epic.
Dana Ortiz: Done. Added recurrence label and linked previous PMs. Also adding a "temp_owner" field to each ticket for PTO coverage.
Kim Barnes: Weekly 15m owner sync until all tickets are In Progress? Wed 9:30am works for me.
SRE Team: Works. Please send the invite and we639;ll post one-line status updates in the PM doc after each sync.
Dana Ortiz: Calendar invite sent. Final ask: update JIRA owner and comment "owner-ack" by EOD so Ops can close the postmortem loop. Thanks all :thumbsup:
